items.title: Iola Brubeck interviewed by Monk Rowe, Wilton, CT, July 17, 2011
items.q: when he was studying with Milhaud at Mills College

ctx.x: Well let me rewind just a little bit again. What gave you the idea that jazz concerts, and Dave in particular, might do well in a college setting?

Oh about the college you mean? That was early. And that came about because when he was studying with Milhaud at Mills College, the musicians there all were full of great ideas and performed a concert that was fundraising for scholarships or something, and it was very enthusiastically received by the college population, especially among the music students. So then it seemed the idea was well we’ll do the same thing at UC Berkeley. So that was set up. And it became more and more apparent that commercially these…
It’s almost a period piece in itself with the LPs “Jazz Goes to College.” Because now jazz lives in college.
